entries.note: HostBridgeError is exported but only constructed inside host-bridge.js itself; no file in the repository imports it, in the template or in the synced spike copy.

pass one: decodeHostResult is imported in the repository (spike/test/*.mjs from spike/src/host-bridge.js, the byte-identical copy the Rakefile syncs from this template). pass two: decodeHostResult is imported in the repository (spike/test/durable-object.mjs, fetch.mjs, runtime.mjs) from spike/src/host-bridge.js, the verbatim copy the Rakefile syncs from this template.

pass one: hostErrorMessage is imported in the repository (spike/test/durable-object.mjs and runtime.mjs from the synced spike/src/host-bridge.js copy of this template). pass two: hostErrorMessage is imported in the repository (spike/test/durable-object.mjs, spike/test/runtime.mjs) from spike/src/host-bridge.js, the verbatim copy the Rakefile syncs from this template.

pass one: spike/Rakefile's TEMPLATE_ASSETS names this file and copies it to spike/src/durable-object.js on every build, aborting if it is missing. pass two: spike/Rakefile's TEMPLATE_ASSETS names runtime/durable-object.js and the build (npm run build -> rake templates) copies it into spike/src, where index.js imports it.

pass one: spike/Rakefile's TEMPLATE_ASSETS names this file and copies it to spike/src/runtime.js on every build, aborting if it is missing. pass two: spike/Rakefile's TEMPLATE_ASSETS names runtime/runtime.js and the build copies it into spike/src/runtime.js, which index.js and the tests import.

pass one: spike/Rakefile names this file and copies it to spike/scripts/generate-bindings.mjs, which package.json runs as a CLI entry point. pass two: spike/Rakefile's TEMPLATE_ASSETS names tools/generate-bindings.mjs and it is copied to scripts/generate-bindings.mjs, the CLI entry point of npm run generate:bindings.
